decisions.reason: As a recent door lever handle family in the firm's core architectural hardware range, it is likely to be retained because German spec-driven suppliers usually preserve such lines for continuity in projects and distribution.
The mitred door lever handle family supports the firm's design-oriented positioning and would normally stay unless sales proved clearly disappointing, which is not indicated here.
This multifunctional door lever handle is more specialized but still fits the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy, so management would more likely keep than withdraw it.
Another door lever handle family remains close to the firm's established business and is likely to be kept to build specification presence across architects, installers and stockists.
The door and window handle collection appears to be a flagship family with dedicated presentation and an award-winning model, making withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.

A finish option is easier to rationalize than a full hardware family, but this light patinated bronze variant still aligns with the firm's premium architecture-led portfolio and is likely to remain available.
